name: session-board
description: Reports this Claude Code session's state (working, needs approval, your turn, ended), last prompt, last answer and ECC progress to a session-board wall display

boardUrl.title: Board URL
boardUrl.description: The board server's address, e.g. http://192.168.0.226:7777. You can paste the whole link board.py prints: a ?token= in it is used as the token, but it is then kept in plain settings; put the token in Token to keep it in secure storage.

token.title: Token
token.description: The board server's access token (--token or SESSION_BOARD_TOKEN). Leave empty when the Board URL carries ?token=.
